records.resolution: Handle explicit reject as well as drop; repeat the positive control against the same endpoint.

records.resolution: Exact file plus UUID-shaped command_key match only; keep canary and full history scan.

records.failure: BuildKit rejected an Alertmanager UI download with a digest different from the pinned upstream checksum. Browser/incident steps did not run.
records.resolution: Preserve checksum rejection. Official API metadata, upstream sha256sums and a separate download all match the pinned digest; a fresh workflow must validate the download again. Cause of the mismatching transfer is unconfirmed.

records.failure: Generic API-key detection matched the source SHA-256 next to the check-api-restart filename in the new local recovery report.
records.resolution: Use separate file and sha256 fields for new reports; allow only the exact historical filename/checksum line in this exact report during Git-history scan. Keep canary and all other secret detections.

policy: Failed workflow outcomes remain available. This summary records observed failures, not a passing report.
